slides.1.title: 🌍 The History of German Wine
slides.1.content: German wine history spans more than 2,000 years, dating back to the Roman Empire. Romans planted the first vineyards along the Rhine and Mosel rivers, leaving a winemaking legacy that continues today. During the Middle Ages, monastic orders cultivated grape varieties across Germany, laying the groundwork for many of the famous estates that still operate today.

slides.5.title: Quick Quiz
slides.5.questions.0.question: What is Germany's most famous white grape variety?
slides.5.questions.0.explanation: Riesling is Germany's most important white grape, renowned for its minerality, high acidity and broad sweetness spectrum — one of the world's greatest white wine varieties.
slides.5.questions.1.question: German wine history can be traced back to which civilisation?
slides.5.questions.1.explanation: Roman legionaries established Germany's earliest vineyards along the Rhine and Mosel — a legacy spanning more than 2,000 years.
